column4: Classifies an error string as session expiry to trigger re-initialize; recovery routing only, no allow/deny.
Pure predicate on HTTP status choosing the retryable error carriage; decides nothing security-relevant.
Matches JSON-RPC error codes/messages that signal session expiry; retry routing, no security decision.
Convenience constructor delegating to new_with_oauth with no OAuth client; checks are made in with_destination.
Swaps the refresh-task handle and aborts the old one; task lifecycle plumbing, decision made by the OAuth client.
Sets the era cache once via OnceLock; dialect plumbing with no security decision.
Non-blocking read of the cached peer era; plain getter.
Stores a hint flag that only enables a debug_assert; no production enforcement.
Aborts the refresh task on drop to avoid leaking a task; cleanup, decides nothing.
Increments an atomic counter to produce a JSON-RPC request id; no decision.
Composes connect (OAuth/token decision) and handshake with no decision of its own.
Chooses legacy-SSE versus Streamable fallback on a 4xx; the version refusal and connected flag are set in legacy_handshake.
Plain getter of the detected transport flavour.
Plain getter falling back to base_url; the origin check is in resolve_message_url when the endpoint is stored.
Plumbing: calls open_listen and maps the result; refusals are decided in open_listen, read_stream and frame.
Getter forwarding streamable().
Maps a refused HTTP status onto a Refused variant; the refusal itself was already decided by the peer response.
Names a JSON value kind for an error message; decides nothing.
Pure line-terminator framing over a byte slice; decides nothing, the size bound is applied in decode.
Parses one already-bounded block into an event; invalid UTF-8 is a format error, and the size refusal is made in decode before this runs.
Appends a chunk and delegates to decode, which makes the bound decision.
Flushes the final block by delegating to decode, which makes the bound decision.
Delegates to notify_with_headers with no headers and the shared bucket; no decision of its own.
Plain getter of the connected flag; decides nothing.
Maps the OAuth task's JoinError (a panic or cancellation) to the Error::OAuth that connect returns; it decides nothing, connect refuses whenever the task fails.
